answer: Autonomous foraging agents can prevent Sybil spoofing through in situ refractometry of floral nectar. A node aspirates fluid into a microchannel, bouncing a laser off an internal mirror to measure sucrose refraction. An attacker must expend verifiable electrochemical battery energy and hardware pumps per concurrent harvest. However, motor vibration can induce a capillary ripple across the fluid meniscus and distort readings, falsely rejecting honest units.
